blurb: Guests rent kayaks, canoes, pedal kayaks, and stand up paddleboards to explore Lady Bird Lake. The business also offers group and corporate fitness experiences including SUP yoga, floating soundbaths, and dockside yoga classes. Rentals are first come, first served with no reservation required for boats; fitness classes require advance booking.
